turnaround_reason: Simply Good Foods fell ~60% from ~$28 to ~$11 after Atkins collapsed (retail takeaway -23%) and the OWYN acquisition disappointed, forcing a guidance cut and strategic overhaul. The bet is that Quest strength plus cost cuts and a returning CEO restore margins and stabilize the portfolio.
bullish_points: Cheap for a branded, cash-generative food company: forward P/E ~6.7, P/B ~0.71, EV/EBITDA ~6.2, with positive FCF of ~$107M
Insider conviction: Chairman James Kilts bought ~$991k at $12.39 and director Daley ~$118k at $11.78 in 2026
Self-help underway: Joe Scalzo returned as CEO, ~$17M annual cost savings, margin restoration and brand reinvestment prioritized
Quest (the growth brand) still positive (+2.4% takeaway) and has been the driver as Atkins fades
Consistent EPS beats (Q3 0.42 vs 0.35; Q2 0.45 vs 0.40) and analyst mean target ~$14.4 with a buy rating
bearish_points: Core Atkins brand (24% of sales) is in steep secular decline (-23% takeaway, worsening), and OWYN integration explicitly 'did not meet expectations'
Reported profit margin is negative (-14%) reflecting impairment/writedowns; TTM revenue growth -6.3%
Total company retail takeaway down ~6.4%; the turnaround is early and unproven
GLP-1/appetite-suppressant headwinds hang over the entire protein-snack/meal-replacement category
catalyst: Q4/FY2026 earnings showing margin recovery from cost cuts and Atkins decline moderating while Quest/OWYN stabilize
suggested_trade: Small spot starter only (~$11) as a cheap value/insider-buy setup; wait for evidence Atkins decline is moderating before adding
key_risk: Atkins keeps deteriorating faster than Quest can offset, and category-wide GLP-1 pressure caps any brand recovery
would_skip_if: Next print shows continued portfolio-wide takeaway declines with no margin stabilization from the cost program
